response.justification: Bogdan is a genuinely senior/staff-level generalist with 15+ years of shipping production software across web, backend, embedded and infrastructure, plus a CS bachelor's degree and strong engineering-excellence credentials (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, public workshops). However, the role's core requirement — 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions — is not met; AI exposure appears limited to roughly one year of MCP code generators and agentic tooling at re:cinq. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases, no RAG architectures, no multi-agent frameworks, no LLM evaluation/observability work, and only modest cloud depth (AWS CDK). Consulting/customer-facing technical discovery is also not evidenced. Worth a screening call only if the team is willing to hire a strong engineer who will ramp into the GenAI stack.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems; staff-level scope and mentoring/teaching track record
Strong TypeScript/Node.js depth plus recent MCP and agentic-workflow tooling experience
Proven polyglot adaptability, testing rigor (TDD, CI/CD), and Kubernetes/Docker delivery
concerns: No RAG, vector database, or multi-agent framework experience shown
Python absent from skills; AI work appears to span ~1 year, not 8+
Limited cloud-scale AI architecture, data pipelines, and customer-facing consulting evidence

key_factors.factor: Missing Python and cloud AI platform work
